board.text: Injury opportunity: Jalon Daniels (QB, TB) steps in for Baker Mayfield (Out) and nobody has him - proj 12.0, league is on him. 3 free next-men in total.
Woody Marks (BN3, value 5.6/wk) - Upgrade after this week (his best week is now): drop for Ollie Gordon (+3.3/wk)

Waiver: worth a claim - Ollie Gordon (RB, MIA, value 8.8/wk) - Values 3.3/wk above your weakest flex-eligible bench player; fade risk (67% of seasons like his fall off); last 3 weeks 7.6 ppg; rising; drop Woody Marks (+3.3/wk) (also on 2 rival wish list(s))
Morgan is shopping Alvin Kamara, Jacory Croskey-Merritt, Tre Tucker, Tyler Warren: nothing there beats what you would have to give - pass, or wait for the price to drop

Week 5 bye: Harrison Butker (K #20) - keep him: the best free K is level with him this week, but #20 at K is not a rank you give away for one bye. Plan: claim Spencer Shrader (IND, 10.3/wk) for that week and drop Dontayvion Wicks (WR, 7.5/wk, your least valuable bench man) to hold both; drop Spencer Shrader again in week 6 when Harrison Butker is back
Week 5 bye: Chiefs D/ST (DST #9) - replaceable, and worth no more than Dontayvion Wicks. Stream him: claim Ravens D/ST (BAL, 6.7/wk) that week in his spot, then take the best free DST back in week 6
Next week: Harrison Butker is on bye - plan the replacement now
